Project CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

Complements /opt/devbox/CLAUDE.md for this repository. AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md hold the full detail; this file is the short version.

Project overview

onedevr (display name onedevR) is an R client for the OneDev REST API: issues, iterations, boards, builds, pull requests, projects, users, packages. Public, general-purpose, od_* prefix, modelled on gitlabr. OneDev is the API target; code is hosted on GitHub (alexseymer/onedevR). A change is done when it meets the Definition of Done in project_plan.md §11: roxygen docs with example, _pkgdown.yml entry, at least one offline test, a NEWS.md entry, no new R CMD check warnings.

Stack

  • R package (DESCRIPTION), R 4.6. Runtime deps: httr2, jsonlite, rlang, tibble, vctrs (fixed dependency budget, enforced by tests/testthat/test-principles.R).
  • Dev: testthat, mockery, withr, devtools, roxygen2, knitr, rmarkdown, pkgdown.
  • External: a OneDev instance, only for live tests. pkgdown site on GitHub Pages (gh-pages branch).
  • .cursor/Dockerfile defines the Cursor Cloud image, not a runtime service.

How to build and test

Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'                  # regenerate man/ and NAMESPACE
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'                      # offline unit tests
Rscript -e 'devtools::check(args = "--no-manual")' # full check
Rscript -e 'pkgdown::check_pkgdown()'              # every export in _pkgdown.yml

On the devbox, R is not installed on the host; run these in the dev image built from .cursor/Dockerfile:

docker build -f .cursor/Dockerfile -t onedevr-dev .cursor
docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work \
  -e HOME=/tmp onedevr-dev Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'

Live tests: ONEDEV_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 plus ONEDEV_HOST and a token in .Renviron (gitignored; see .env.example and LIVE-TESTS.md). R reads the mounted .Renviron in the container; pass -e ONEDEV_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1. Writing tests also need ONEDEV_LIVE_ALLOW_WRITES=1. Never print or commit those values. The live-tests.yaml workflow uses repository secrets of the same names. Comment debugging: scripts/diagnose-comments.R.

Conventions

  • Linux principle (CONTRIBUTING.md, “Design principles”): one function per OneDev operation, object first, conn and options last, no prompts, no stdout output from library code (use message()).
  • Edit roxygen comments in R/, never man/*.Rd or NAMESPACE by hand.
  • Unit tests stay offline (stub HTTP with mockery, env with withr).
  • Unverified areas are marked experimental; promote only after a live test.
  • Commits: imperative summary line, one topic per branch, merged via PR. Every user-visible change gets a NEWS.md entry.

Personas in this project

No .agents/personas/ overrides yet. Cursor: roxygen docs, offline tests, mechanical refactors. agy: review before a release and of API-shape decisions that are not backed by tod or the OneDev REST help.
